On fertilizer, I will take a moderate, yield-oriented approach: enough nitrogen to support vegetative growth and boll setting, enough phosphorus for rooting and early vigor, and enough potassium to support boll development and fiber quality. Since this is the start of the season, I will plan my irrigations around establishment, squaring, flowering, and boll filling, but I will keep the number controlled because too much water can push excessive vegetative growth in cotton. I will also plan several pesticide applications because cotton in my area can easily run into aphids, bollworms, and other pests if I wait too long. Overall, I will run a practical cotton-only plan that fits my experience, my irrigation access, and the labor I actually have.
